heading: More reliable terminal triggers and passwords
summary: Send multiline trigger replies, see accurate password save status, and keep your workspace navigation after restarting.
changes: Each line is sent with Return. A trailing newline does not add an empty command.
Manage triggers beside Snippets and keep each rule's enabled state across restarts.
Know whether a password was saved
The connection form keeps the entered value and reports success, rejection, a server that did not request it, or a storage failure.
Keep sidebar selection and history order
The selected sidebar tab returns after restart, and connection history remains newest first.
Restoring a saved workspace keeps currently running sessions open.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
